items.title: Yoro red card overturned, but refs' chief Webb backs decision
items.summary: Manchester United defender Leny Yoro is clear to face Brentford on Saturday as his red card at Anfield is overturned.

items.title: Ref chief Webb backs process around Yoro sending off despite successful appeal
items.summary: Referees' chief Howard Webb has backed the process of the officials who sent off Manchester United defender Leny Yoro at Liverpool - despite the red card being overturned on appeal.

items.title: VI Live: PSV Onder-19 geeft goede voorbeeld met gelijkspel in Madrid
items.summary: PSV staat dinsdagavond voor een ware Champions League-kraker tegen Real Madrid. De Eindhovenaren kunnen een stunt stiekem goed gebruiken, want zij staan virtueel op de rand van wel of geen Europees vervolg. In aanloop naar en vanaf de aftrap om 21.00 uur blijf je in deze VI Live volledig op de hoogte.

items.title: Analyse: dit kan AZ verwachten van Sparta Praag
items.summary: AZ treft met Sparta Praag een ploeg in chaotische omstandigheden. Oude bekende Brian Priske is de laan uitgestuurd en de resultaten zijn niet goed. Tactische analyse van de aanstaande tegenstander van AZ in de Europa League.

items.title: VI Live: start Ernst of Kastenmeier? Hadj Moussa terugverwacht in de basis
items.summary: Feyenoord staat dinsdagavond om 21.00 uur tegenover FC Porto in de Champions League. De Rotterdammers hebben net als de Portugese ploeg van Francesco Farioli pas drie punten verzameld in het miljardenbal, virtueel niet genoeg voor een Europees vervolg. Mis in deze VI Live niets van Feyenoord tegen FC Porto.

items.title: VI Live: Maatsen en Mbuyamba trappen bomvolle Champions League-avond af
items.summary: Joey Veerman gaat dinsdagavond met Borussia Dortmund op bezoek bij Premier League-kampioen Arsenal. Manchester City neemt het op tegen Napoli. De duels van Feyenoord en PSV volg je in een apart liveblog, in deze VI Live blijf je op de hoogte van alle andere Champions League-duels.

items.title: Tiental Feyenoord verliest foutloze Youth League-status tegen Porto
items.summary: Feyenoord Onder-19 heeft voor het eerst punten laten liggen in de competitiefase van de UEFA Youth League. Op Varkenoord moesten de Rotterdammers, mede door een rode kaart, hun meerdere erkennen in FC Porto.

items.title: Manchester United win appeal over Yoro’s one-match suspension after Anfield red card
items.summary: Mauricio Pochettino said after game it was ‘never a foul’ Player now eligible to face Brentford on Saturday Manchester United have successfully appealed against the decision to send off Leny Yoro in their 4-0 defeat to Liverpool. The defender was dismissed for denying an obvious goal scoring opportunity after eight minutes but this was found to be incorrect. The Frenchman will no longer be required to serve a one-match suspicion. He fouled Liverpool’s Alexander Isak when through on goal in the early stages at Anfield but Mauricio Pochettino insisted the striker would not have reached the ball, and therefore is was not a sending off offence. The referee Sam Barrott made a different assessment, which the video assistant did not disagree with. Continue reading...

items.summary: The 2026 Ladbrokes Players Championship Finals sees 64 players competing to win the PDC's last major event before the World Darts Championship gets under way in December.

items.title: Millwall face partial stadium closure after discriminatory chants
items.summary: Millwall must play a home game in front of a partially-closed stadium as punishment for fans' discriminatory chants.

items.title: Senegal restored as Africa Cup of Nations champions after court ruling
items.summary: Senegal won January’s final 1-0 after walking off Result was overturned in March as 3-0 win for Morocco Senegal have been restored as the Africa Cup of Nations champions after a ruling by the court of arbitration for sport (Cas). Senegal beat Morocco 1-0 in a chaotic Afcon final in January but the result was overturned two months later as a 3-0 default win for Morocco by an appeals panel appointed by the Confederation of African Football (Caf). Continue reading...

items.title: Senegal confirmed AFCON 2025 champions after appeal
items.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) has announced Senegal as the winners of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON).

items.title: ‘I’m loving it at Brugge’: Freddie Potts on going from West Ham’s bench to Champions League
items.summary: Midfielder is preparing to face Liverpool after leaving the club he loves and overcoming a tough start in Belgium In April Freddie Potts was absorbing the disappointment of being substituted at half-time during West Ham’s FA Cup quarter-final defeat by Leeds. The midfielder was out of favour under Nuno Espírito Santo and could not have imagined that he would be preparing to face Liverpool in the Champions League seven months later. It is the 23-year-old’s reward for taking the difficult decision to leave his boyhood club last summer. Potts noticed his minutes were drying up in pre-season, even though West Ham were not exactly stocked with talent after relegation, and was ready for a new challenge when Club Brugge offered about £10m to sign him. Continue reading...

items.title: Palace docked points for using four sub windows in WSL win
items.summary: Crystal Palace say they are "disappointed" by the ruling which they "do not agree is reasonable or proportionate".

items.title: Crystal Palace docked three WSL points for extra substitution against Everton
items.summary: Too many substitutes used during win in opening game They drop place to 13th but no extra points for Everton Crystal Palace have been deducted three points in the Women’s Super League after they made substitutions in four separate windows during their 1-0 victory over Everton in September. Palace admitted breaching the competition’s rules and an independent tribunal ordered the points deduction, but no points will be awarded to Everton. It means Palace drop from 12th to 13th, below Birmingham City on goal difference. The match will not be replayed. Continue reading...

items.summary: Het was een enorme domper op de feestvreugde in Eindhoven drie weken geleden: de blessure van Jan Virgili. Nu is er drie weken later eindelijk goed nieuws vanop het front van de winger. Of hij ook de match tegen Liverpool haalt? Dat is weer iets helemaal anders.

items.title: Ivan Leko laat er geen enkele twijfel over bestaan: ferme verwittiging voor Liverpool

Makkelijk wordt het niet tegen de Engelse topclub, maar helemaal uitgesloten is niets meer na de resultaten in Eindhoven en dergelijke meer.

items.title: Le pire se confirme : quatre mois d'indisponibilité pour un ancien Diable !
items.summary: L'Ajax pourrait avoir payé cher sa large victoire contre l'ADO La Haye (3-0). Jorthy Mokio a été contraint de quitter la pelouse sur blessure en fin de rencontre. L'international congolais de 18 ans avait pourtant inscrit un but un peu plus tôt dans le match.
